label: Town of Wardsboro
header:
# Town of Wardsboro municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 25; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Wardsboro, Town Officials page (wardsborovt.gov): lists the current five-member Selectboard -- Duane Tompkins (Chair), Peter Sebastian (Vice Chair), Clarence 'Dewey' Ballantine Jr., Michael S. Fitzpatrick Jr., and Mitch Plimpton. The June 2026 Secretary of State directory's four rows (incl. 'Harvey Plimpton,' no Tompkins) are stale; the 2026 report's fifth pre-meeting member, Diane Schips, held a one-year seat expiring in 2026, and Plimpton holds a 2026-warned one-year seat
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk; Wardsboro's 2026 Warning (Art. 2a) elects the clerk for a one-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Michelle Hull as Wardsboro's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Michelle Hull as Wardsboro's Town Clerk

Town of Wardsboro, Cemetery Commissioners meeting notice (September 10, 2026): signed 'Michelle Hull, Town Clerk.' Hull's seat stood at the March 2026 meeting with no published outcome; the September 2026 signature and both June 2026 Secretary of State sources present her as the current clerk (incumbent-continuity mint, disclosed on #163)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer; Wardsboro's 2026 Warning (Art. 2b) elects the treasurer for a one-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Michelle Hull as Wardsboro's Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Michelle Hull as Wardsboro's Town Treasurer

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term; John Moran held the office to 2026 per the 2026 report and the 2026 floor-vote outcome (Warning Art. 1) is unpublished); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

offices.title: Auditor
offices.org_name: Town of Wardsboro Board of Auditors

sources.note: Town of Wardsboro, 2026 Annual Town Report, 'Elected Town Officials' list: lists Leigh Ann Varese (term to 2028) and Julie McNeal (term to 2027); Patricia Hayes's seat expired in 2026 (Warning Art. 2g), outcome unpublished -- straggler. Hayes is seated as a Trustee of Public Funds

offices.title: Lister
offices.org_name: Town of Wardsboro Board of Listers

sources.note: Town of Wardsboro, Town Officials page: presents Janice Hull, Leigh Ann Varese, and Katryna Fitzpatrick as the current listers (the page governs currency; Varese's report-listed term expired in 2026). Varese is also an auditor; one record carries both memberships

Town of Wardsboro, 2026 Annual Town Report, 'Elected Town Officials' list: lists five commissioners on five-year terms -- Christopher Shea (to 2030), James Hescock (to 2029), Nancy Dawson (to 2028), Jane Robinson (to 2027), and Janice Hull (to 2026, confirmed serving in September 2026: she signs the commission's September 10, 2026 meeting notice as Acting Secretary). DIVERGENCE: the town's Boards & Committees page names Dewey Ballantine a commissioner and omits Robinson; the term-structured report governs (disclosed on #163). Dawson is the Justice of the Peace Nancy Clark Dawson; one record carries both

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Wardsboro Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes; Michelle Hull held the office to 2026 per the 2026 report, the seat stood in 2026 (Warning Art. 2j), and no current source styles her in the office); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a first constable; the 2026 report shows the seat vacant into 2026 and the 2026 outcome (Warning Art. 2i) is unpublished); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a town agent; the 2026 report shows the office vacant and the 2026 outcome (Warning Art. 2k) is unpublished); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

offices.org_name: Town of Wardsboro Trustees of Public Funds

sources.note: Town of Wardsboro, 2026 Annual Town Report, 'Elected Town Officials' list: lists Patricia Hayes (term to 2028) and Thomas Almeida (term to 2027); Mike Cooney's seat expired in 2026 (Warning Art. 2h), outcome unpublished -- straggler

Town of Wardsboro, 2026 Annual Town Report, 'Elected Town Officials' list: the report's own list fixes the board at seven seats and names Patricia Rappazzo (to 2028), Donna Fernandes (to 2028), Sheri Lewis (to 2027), Karina Martin (to 2027), and Steve Herd (to 2027). The two seats warned in 2026 (Warning Arts. 2m/2n -- Martin Loftus's seat and a vacant seat) have no published outcome -- stragglers

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of Wardsboro Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Wardsboro justices of the peace: Ken Brace, Nancy Clark Dawson, Nancy Meinhard, Cherie Keeler Moran, and George Wilson

Town of Wardsboro, 2026 Annual Town Report, 'Elected Town Officials' list: the town's own list names only Dawson, Meinhard, and Moran, with '2 vacancies' -- Brace and Wilson have left the office, so only the three surviving winners are seated (departed-winner pattern). Dawson is also a cemetery commissioner; one record carries both memberships

jp_election.name: Town of Wardsboro Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the five winners of Wardsboro's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election (vote for five): Ken Brace, Nancy Clark Dawson, Nancy Meinhard, Cherie Keeler Moran, and George Wilson. The town's 2026 Annual Report lists only Dawson, Meinhard, and Moran in office, with two vacancies, so Brace and Wilson are recorded as winners who no longer hold the seat and are not seated; the winners list holds the three survivors
